headline: From 150 to 1,000 hryvnias per month: which supplement will start being paid from September 1
summary: Ukrainian pensioners will receive monthly supplements on top of basic payments from September 1. The amount ranges from 150 to 1,038 hryvnias depending on category and number of children.
why: Pension payments are a major item of government social spending and affect household incomes and the state budget.
